records.completeness_basis: Counted the 72 entries under 'Undergraduate Programs > Bachelor Degrees' on the official Programs page (prints '2026-2028 Catalog'), each award its own linked entry as our records are keyed (Physics BA and BS counted separately; Mechanical Engineering BS listed twice, San Luis Obispo and Solano campuses, counted as two). Excluded minors, masters, graduate/undergraduate certificates, credential programs, ROTC and Honors. 64 of 72 have verified bachelor records; unverified: Aerospace Engineering BS, Architecture BArch, Biomedical Engineering BS, Electrical Engineering BS, Landscape Architecture BLA, Materials Engineering BS, Mechanical Engineering BS (SLO), Mechanical Engineering BS (Solano). After the 5 program pages beneath department pages (Aerospace, Biomedical, Electrical, Materials Engineering BS; Architecture BArch) were reviewed and verified, 69 listed entries have a verified record; Landscape Architecture (BLA) and the two Mechanical Engineering (BS) campus entries do not.
